subject: Request: short-stop demo subsidy while procurement finishes
messages:
From: Jorge Carvajal <jorge.carvajal@brightwell.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procure@brightwell.ai
Date: 2027-04-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask — procurement delaying PO, can you patch the demo?

Hi Ava,

We're excited about spinning up Redwood for a 2-week pilot, but our procurement team is taking longer than expected to finish the PO and security checklist. We have stakeholders ready to validate the integration this week and don't want momentum to stall.

Is there any way you can temporarily extend our trial window or provide a small run of credits so our engineers can finish the end-to-end tests while legal/finance nails down the PO? Even a 7–10 day buffer would keep the demo schedule intact. I attached the onboarding checklist so you can see the scope.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Jorge
Head of Platform Partnerships
Brightwell Analytics

Subject: Re: Quick ask — procurement delaying PO, can you patch the demo?

Hi Jorge — thanks for the heads up and the checklist. Appreciate the context.

Short answer: yes, we can help keep the pilot live. I can authorize a 10-day sandbox uplift (temporary credits) so your engineers can complete integration tests while procurement finalizes the PO.

Quick notes:
- The uplift is time-boxed and will expire automatically after 10 days.
- We'll not change any billing settings; once PO is in place we can convert the pilot to an ordered environment.
- If you expect more than ~200k tokens/day during that window, let me know so we can size the uplift.

I've looped in Marissa (AE) and Logan (solutions) to confirm the amount and to get a doc in place that records the dates. For audit we typically document the uplift amount and end date in HubSpot.

Want me to go ahead and provision the credits now?

— Ava
Sr. Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

We've provisioned a temporary 10-day demo subsidy for Brightwell: 300k token credit, active from 2027-04-29T12:00:00-07:00 through 2027-05-09T12:00:00-07:00. This is a one-time operational allowance to preserve the demo.

Logistics:
- I'll add an internal note on the HubSpot deal (BW-2027-0428) and attach the provisioning record.
- If procurement completes and we get the PO before the window ends, we'll reconcile usage and convert remaining credits to the committed seat if requested.
- For compliance, Logan — can you share the short audit stub documenting that this subsidy doesn't change data retention or SLA?

Jorge — you should see the sandbox credits appear in your project within the next hour. Ping me if you don't.

Best,
